body:
Resolves #845.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `parsePorcelain` in `plugins/adlc-pi/lib/reactive-gate.mjs` decodes git C-style quoted paths (octal UTF-8 byte escapes `\ooo` and standard C escapes `\\`, `\"`, `\t`, `\n`, `\r`, `\a`, `\b`, `\f`, `\v`) and handles quoted rename sources (`"old" -> "new"`) when `core.quotePath` is enabled.
2. Unit tests in `plugins/adlc-pi/test/reactive-gate.test.mjs` verify C-escaped paths (including octal UTF-8 sequences, escaped quotes/backslashes/tabs, and quoted renames) are decoded accurately so rail and suppression checks match the real filesystem path.
title: plugin(adlc-pi): decode C-escaped git status --porcelain paths in parsePorcelain (#845)
